cards.name: Michael Wong
cards.text: Awesome dive spots with crystal clear water and plenty of marine life. The gear was solid and the guide knew his stuff. Dropping one star only because the boat felt a bit cramped for our group. Still, an unforgettable experience — would definitely recommend.

cards.name: Avril Song
cards.text: Such a magical experience swimming with sea turtles and colorful fish! The team was friendly and made me feel safe as a beginner. Giving 4 stars because the briefing felt a little rushed before the dive. Otherwise, stunning views and great value for money.

cards.name: Jeane Wood
cards.text: Absolutely flawless experience from start to finish. Professional, attentive staff, pristine equipment, and the underwater scenery was breathtaking — like swimming in an aquarium. They even accommodated my request for a smaller group. One of the best dives of my life. Highly recommend!

cards.name: William Murderface
cards.text: This was total garbage. I went down there to feel something, maybe get attacked by a shark or drown dramatically, but no. Just a bunch of happy fish and coral. The dive instructor kept smiling at me. Disgusting. The water pressure didn’t even crush my organs right. One star because I can’t give zero. Murderface does not recommend.
cards.description: The hero of the series Metalocalypse William Murderface

cards.name: Nathan Explosion
cards.text: Brutal in theory. Underwater. Silence. Death all around. But in practice… not brutal. Too many colors. Fish were being friendly. The guide asked if I was 'having fun.' Fun? No. Give me a shipwreck with skeletons. Two stars for the cold water and the one moment I thought my regulator was failing. False alarm. Weak.
cards.description: The hero of the series Metalocalypse Nathan Explosion

cards.name: Pickles
cards.text: Alright, so, the diving part was kinda cool — saw some weird fish, felt like I was in a music video for like five minutes. But the boat left at 8 AM, man. Eight in the morning. No beer on board. The gear smelled like someone else’s wetsuit farts. Guide was nice but way too chipper. Three stars for the vibes underwater, but come on, where’s the after-party? Not brutal, not amazing — just… medium.
cards.description: The hero of the series Metalocalypse Pickles
